activeForm: Removing the program preamble from extension artifacts
description:
FILED s401 (Fable review probes, docs/fable-answers-s400.md Â§9).

WHAT: cl/pcl-pack.lisp, cl/pcl-mro.lisp, cl/pcl-warnings.lisp are loaded LAZILY
by p-load-extension (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~16854, a plain `load`) at the first
pack/unpack, mro::*, warnings::enabled call.  Each begins with the PROGRAM
preamble pl2cl emits for every file:

    (setf pcl::*pcl-pl2cl-path* #P"/home/bernt/pcl/pl2cl")
    (setf pcl::@INC (make-array 0 :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))
    (vector-push-extend "/home/bernt/pcl/cl" pcl::@INC)   ... 8 build-machine dirs
    (setf pcl::*p-core-inc-dirs* (list ...))

so the running program's @INC is REPLACED by the build machine's list the
moment it first calls pack.

PROBED vs perl 5.40.3 (scratchpad incprobe.pl / incprobe4.pl):

    push @INC, "/tmp/mylib"; my $p = pack("N", 42);
    print scalar(grep { $_ eq "/tmp/mylib" } @INC);   perl: 1    PCL: 0  (silent)

    push @INC, $dir; pack("N",1); require MyLocal;   perl: loads
                                                    PCL: Can't locate MyLocal.pm in @INC

(A `use lib`/BEGIN push also vanishes from @INC â probed, kept=0 â but a
later `require` may still succeed because the transpile-time module
resolution runs elsewhere; the runtime-push shape is the one that dies.)
On another machine the reset would also point *pcl-pl2cl-path* at a
non-existent path after the first pack, breaking every later string eval.

WHY THIS IS #217: the artifacts embed the author's absolute paths BECAUSE
they carry a program preamble they never needed â an extension loads INTO a
program whose own preamble already set all three.

FIX (ruled s401, one mechanism):
  1. `pl2cl --extension` (module-artifact mode): emit NO program preamble
     (no *pcl-pl2cl-path*, no @INC init, no *p-core-inc-dirs*); keep the
     line-1 gen stamp (artifact-staleness-01.t discovers artifacts by it)
     and the (in-package)/(p-defpackage) lines the body needs.
  2. tools/rebuild-pack (and the mro/warnings regeneration commands in
     cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~16295/~16321) pass the flag; regenerate all three.
  3. Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t: the artifact EXCLUSION goes away â the
     count row becomes "0 excluded" and the artifacts are scanned like any
     hand-written source (the guard TIGHTENS).
  4. Rule-12 guard in p-load-extension: assert @INC (identity/length) and
     the two specials are unchanged across the `load`; die naming the
     extension if not â so a future artifact regression is loud.
  5. #217 CLOSES; #277 item 2 (installer regenerates artifacts) is DELETED â
     the artifacts are machine-independent; the installer only warns when
     the checkout's compiler is newer than their stamps.

MEASURE FIRST: a temporary before/after @INC compare in p-load-extension over
ONE full sweep â how many perl-tests files hit the reset today (files that
write @INC at runtime and then call pack).  Record the number here.

BAR: user-file emission untouched -> tools/corpus-diff.pl IDENTICAL, no gen
bump; the three artifacts regenerated + pack.t 5636/89 (sweep-diff 0 new);
gate; the probes above byte-identical to perl; Pl/t row for the guard (a
scratch extension that pushes to @INC must DIE at load).


DONE s404 (commit d1ecafc).  `pl2cl --extension` (no program preamble;
differs from --module only in that diagnostics stay on), all three artifacts
regenerated with zero absolute paths, rule-12 guard in p-load-extension
(dies naming the extension if @INC / *pcl-pl2cl-path* / *p-core-inc-dirs*
changed across the load), no-hardcoded-paths-01.t tightened from "excluded"
to "scanned", new Pl/t/extension-preamble-01.t (5 rows).

POPULATION (the task's MEASURE FIRST, temporary instrumentation over one full
sweep): 17 extension loads in 14 test files, all pcl-pack, EVERY ONE losing
an @INC entry — 13 the program's own source dir, 4 (fresh_perl/runperl
children) their /tmp.  No perl-tests file also pushed at runtime before
calling pack, so the loss was latent in that population.

Sweep after: GATE clean, TOTAL 18516 = baseline, DROPS 12 = 12; pack.t
5636/89 (blessed numbers).  #217 CLOSES with this.
subject: SILENT WRONG: the checked-in artifacts (pcl-pack/mro/warnings) carry a PROGRAM preamble that RESETS @INC (+ *pcl-pl2cl-path*, *p-core-inc-dirs*) when they load at first pack()/mro/warnings::enabled â closes #217 via pl2cl --extension
